steps.title: Boil salted water
steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it generously, it should taste like the sea.

steps.title: Prep the garlic
steps.instruction: Peel and thinly slice 4 cloves of garlic. Slice a chili too, if using.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.instruction: Add 200 g of spaghetti to the boiling water and cook until just shy of al dente. Reserve a cup of pasta water before draining.

steps.title: Sauté the garlic
steps.instruction: Warm 4 tbsp of olive oil over medium-low heat. Add the garlic and chili, and cook gently until golden, don't let it brown.

steps.title: Combine
steps.instruction: Add the drained pasta to the pan with a splash of the reserved pasta water. Toss until glossy and well coated.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Off the heat, stir through grated parmesan, chopped parsley, and a good crack of black pepper.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Plate immediately while hot, with extra cheese on the side.
